feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 10 October 2026 10:32pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 10 October 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind in places at first tonight, and again later on Sunday.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving area of low pressure in the Norwegian Sea will track northeast as a transient ridge of high pressure slowly arrives over our area from the west tonight.


##Wind##

West-northwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in places at first tonight, decreasing 2 to 4 by dawn on Sunday, backing south or southeast 4 or 5 late afternoon and evening, occasionally 6 in the southwest of the area later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming mainly slight overnight, then slight or moderate during Sunday evening.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, becoming mainly fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast 5 or 6, veering south or south-southwest 4 or 5 during Monday morning, increasing 5 or 6 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight or moderate during Monday.


##Weather##

Rain or drizzle spreading from the west overnight, largely clearing during Monday morning but the risk of mist and fog patches.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle. Occasionally poor or very poor in any mist & fog patches.
